fix_subject: Fix interval comparison when carrying left leaves a negative field

labels.summary: interval_t::Normalize used truncating division, so values like 1 month -4 days stayed unnormalized and compared incorrectly (e.g. INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 4 DAY was not equal to INTERVAL 26 DAY), which also broke RANGE window frames over interval order keys; the fix borrows after each carry and saturates Borrow() on overflow.
